ReturningToPrayer.6: Amanyathelo ngokubanzi okuqalisa kwakhona iswala emva kwexesha lenyanga, ngoxolo lwentliziyo.
ReturningToPrayer.8: Lo mxholo wezemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yezenkolo mayiqinisekiswe zizazi ezifanelekileyo. I-AWA ayikhupheli fatwa okanye izigwebo zenkolo ezizenzelwe wena.
ReturningToPrayer.12: Ukuqalisa kwakhona iswala, ngaphandle kokuzalisa eziphosiweyo
ReturningToPrayer.14: I-Ghusl kukuhlamba okukhulu kwenkolo: kukuhlamba umzimba wonke ngenjongo yokubuyela kwimeko yococeko lwenkolo (tahara), ekubalulekileyo ukwenza iswala nezinye iindlela zonqulo.
ReturningToPrayer.15: Phambi kokwenza i-ghusl, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuba ixesha lenyanga liphelele ngokwenene: i-ghusl mayilandele, ingandulelanga, ukuqiniseka ukuba ukopha kuyekile. Ngokubanzi, esi siphelo siyaziwa ngokuyeka ngokupheleleyo kokopha, okubonwe ixesha elaneleyo ukuphelisa nayiphi na ingxaki — inqaku eliqukunjelwe ngokweenkcukacha kwinqaku elinikezelwe kucoceko lwenkolo.
ReturningToPrayer.16: Olu coceko luvumela ukuba ubuyele kwimizuzu yonqulo eyayimiswe ngexesha lenyanga.
ReturningToPrayer.18: Akukho mfuneko yokuziva ukhawulezisa: i-ghusl inokwenziwa kwangoko xa sele ukulungele, ngaphandle koxinzelelo, xa sele isiphelo sexesha lenyanga siqinisekisiwe.
ReturningToPrayer.19: I-Ghusl isekelwe kumgaqo-nkqubo ofanayo ngokubanzi: injongo yokuzicocisa, nokuhlamba ngokupheleleyo umzimba, kuquka iinwele nolusu. Iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo zendlela, nangona kunjalo, zinokwahluka ngokweskolo sezomthetho wenkolo osilandelayo.
ReturningToPrayer.21: Akukho ndlela ithile ibonakaliswa apha njengeyona isebenzayo kuphela: ukubhekisa kwiskolo okanye kwimbono oqhele ukuyilandela, okanye ukucela ingxelo kwisazi esifanelekileyo, kuya kukunceda ufunde iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo ezifanele imeko yakho.
ReturningToPrayer.22: Ukuba ixesha lenyanga liphelile kwaye i-ghusl yenziwe, iswala iqhubeka ngokwesiqhelo, ngaphandle kokulibala okuthile okanye imeko eyongezelelweyo.
ReturningToPrayer.23: Kuncedisa ukwahlula iimeko ezimbini ezilandela imigaqo eyahlukileyo: iiswala ezingenziwanga ngexesha lenyanga zihlala zingazaliswa, ngelixa imihla yokuzila eyaphoswa ngexesha leRamadan kufuneka izaliswe kamva (qadaa).
ReturningToPrayer.24: Umzekelo, umfazi osexesheni iintsuku ezi-6 uqalisa iswala ngokwesiqhelo emva kwe-ghusl, engafuni kuzalisa iiswala zezo ntsuku zi-6. Iintsuku ezi-6 zokuzila ezihambelanayo, nangona kunjalo, ziya kuzaliswa emva kweRamadan.
ReturningToPrayer.26: Ukwenza i-ghusl (ukuhlamba okukhulu) ukubuyela kucoceko lwenkolo
ReturningToPrayer.28: Ukwazi ukuba iiswala ezaphoswa ngexesha lenyanga zihlala zingazaliswa
ReturningToPrayer.29: Ukucela ingxelo kwisazi esifanelekileyo kuyo nayiphi na imeko ethile okanye ukuthandabuza okuqhubekayo

SideEffects.6: Eminye imiphumo inokuba yeqhelekileyo kwaye yethutyana. Eminye ifuna ingqwalaselo engakumbi. Funda ukwahlula phakathi kokusabela okuqhelekileyo nemiqondiso ekufuneka ihlolwe.
SideEffects.14: Xa umntu eqala indlela entsha yokuthintela uzalo ene-hormone, umzimba ungafuna ixesha ukuziqhelanisa. Utshintsho oluncinci lunokuvela kumjikelo, kwimood, okanye kunqabiseko lomzimba.
SideEffects.15: Le miphumo ihlala ithambile kwaye inokuncipha ngokuthe ngcembe. Ubukho bayo ayithethi ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba indlela iyingozi okanye ukuba kufuneka iyekwe.
SideEffects.17: Ukopha okungaqhelekanga kunokwenzeka, ngakumbi ekuqaleni kwendlela entsha.
SideEffects.19: Ukuqina okanye ukuvuvukala kwamabele kunokuvakala okwethutyana.
SideEffects.21: Abanye abantu bayabona utshintsho kwimood okanye ukuvakalelwa ngakumbi.
SideEffects.23: Iintloko ezibuhlungu ezithambileyo zinokwenzeka ngexesha lokuziqhelanisa.
SideEffects.24: Iiveki okanye imijikelo yokuqala inokwahluka koko wawuqhele ngaphambili. Umzimba unokuziqhelanisa ngokuthe ngcembe nesilinganiselo esitsha seehomoni.
SideEffects.26: Umphumo ovela kungekudala emva kokuqala indlela kufanelekile ukuba ujongwe ngokuhamba kwexesha. Ukuba uyakhathaza okanye uyaqhubeka, thetha nengcali yezempilo.
SideEffects.27: Kunokuba luncedo ukubhala iimpawu kwi-app yakho ukulandelela ngcono indlela etshintsha ngayo kumjikelo nomjikelo.
SideEffects.32: Jonga ukuba iyalunga okanye iyabuya iba mbi.
SideEffects.33: Ayizizo zonke iimpawu ezidibene nokuthintela uzalo ngokuqinisekileyo. Uxinzelelo, ukulala, ukutya, umjikelo wakho, okanye ezinye iindlela zokunyanga zinokuchaphazela indlela ovakalelwa ngayo.
SideEffects.34: Ukuqonda imeko, zama ukujonga imeko iphela kunokujonga impawu enye yodwa.
SideEffects.37: Ukopha okungaqhelekanga okuthatha imijikelo engaphezu kwe-3
SideEffects.38: Isicaphucaphu okanye iintloko ezibuhlungu eziqhubeka zikuphazamisa
SideEffects.41: Ingaba zivele emva kokuqala okanye ukutshintsha indlela yokuthintela uzalo?
SideEffects.42: Ingaba zithambile, ziyakuphazamisa, okanye zingaqhelekanga ngokwenene kuwe?
SideEffects.43: Ingaba ziyalunga ngokuhamba kwexesha okanye ziyaphindaphindeka?
SideEffects.44: Nokuba impawu ayikhawulezi, inokuba luncedo ukuxoxa ngayo ukuba iyakuphazamisa, iyaqhubeka, okanye ichaphazela ngokwenene umgangatho wobomi bakho.
SideEffects.46: iimpawu ziyaqhubeka, ziba zinkulu, okanye zikuthintela ukuphila ngokwesiqhelo.
SideEffects.47: Ugqirha, umbelekisi, okanye ugqirha wamayeza angakunceda ukuqonda ukuba iimpawu zinokudibana nendlela oyisebenzisayo kwaye ukuba kufuneka ilungiswe.
SideEffects.48: Ezinye iimpawu aziqhelekanga kwaye zifuna uvavanyo lwezonyango olukhawulezileyo. Azithethi ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba kukho ingxaki, kodwa akufuneki zityeshelwe.
SideEffects.50: Funa ingcebiso yezonyango ngokukhawuleza ukuba uvakalelwa, ngokukodwa:
SideEffects.54: Intloko ebuhlungu ngequbuliso, enkulu kakhulu, okanye engaqhelekanga
SideEffects.55: Ingxaki ngequbuliso ekubonweni, ekuthetheni, okanye kumandla
SideEffects.57: Ukuba iimpawu zivela ngequbuliso, zinzima kakhulu, okanye zihamba nobunzima bokuphefumla, ukuziva uzakuwa, okanye enye impawu ebalulekileyo, funa uncedo lwezonyango olukhawulezileyo.
SideEffects.59: Eminye imiphumo inokuvela ekuqaleni kwendlela entsha yokuthintela uzalo ene-hormone.
SideEffects.60: Imiphumo emininzi yethutyana kwaye inokuncipha ngokuhamba kwexesha.
SideEffects.61: Impawu ekhathazayo okanye eqhubekayo kufanelekile ukuba uxoxe ngayo nengcali.
SideEffects.62: Ezinye iimpawu ezingaqhelekanga zifuna ingcebiso yezonyango ekhawulezileyo.
SideEffects.64: Ukumamela umzimba wakho akuthethi ngokuqinisekileyo ukuyeka indlela kwangoko. Bhala oko ukuvakalelwa, jonga indlela etshintsha ngayo, kwaye ucele ingcebiso nanini na xa impawu ikukhathaza.
SideEffects.65: Eli nqaku lenzelwe ukwazisa kwaye alithathi indawo yengcebiso yezonyango ezenzelwe wena. Ukuba une-mpawu enkulu okanye engaqhelekanga, funa ingcebiso kwingcali yezempilo.

SleepHormones.6: Kutheni ukulala kwakho kutshintsha ngokwesigaba somjikelo, nasekupheleni kwexesha lokuya exesheni (menopause).
SleepHormones.14: I-Progesterone inempembelelo ethambileyo yokulala; ukwehla kwayo ekupheleni komjikelo kunokuphazamisa ukulala, kwenze kube lula okanye kuqhekeke.
SleepHormones.16: Ukunyuka kancinane kobushushu bomzimba emva kwe-ovulation kunokwenza nokuba ukulala kube nzima kancinane kwabanye abantu.
SleepHormones.18: Ukungakhululeki komzimba nokudinwa kunokwenza ukulala kube lula.
SleepHormones.20: Ukulala ngokubanzi kuzinzile ngakumbi kubantu abaninzi.
SleepHormones.22: Ukwehla kwe-progesterone kunokwenza ukulala kube lula, kunokuvuka.
SleepHormones.23: Kwi-menopause, ukujika ubusuku yindlela eqhelekileyo yokuvuka, ngenxa yezizathu ezifanayo zehomoni.
SleepHormones.24: Uxinzelelo lunokwandisa ukuphazamiseka kokulala ngexesha lezigaba zomjikelo ezivakalayo ngakumbi. Iindlela ezilula zokuphumla (ukuphefumla, ukolula ngobunono) zinokukunceda uphumle phambi kokulala.
SleepHormones.25: Inkqubo ezinzileyo yokulala negumbi elipholileyo ziyanceda ukunciphisa olu phazamiseko, nangayiphi na iminyaka.
SleepHormones.27: Ukulala nokuvuka ngamaxesha azinzileyo kunceda ukulungelelanisa iwotshi yangaphakathi yakho.
SleepHormones.29: Ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kunokulibazisa ukulala; ukuphumla esikrinini kunceda ukuthula.
SleepHormones.31: Ubushushu obulingeneyo bwenza ukulala kube lula, nangayiphi na iminyaka.
SleepHormones.32: Izinto ezilungileyo ezenziwayo azisoloko zanele. Kunokuba luncedo ukuthetha nengcali ukuba:
SleepHormones.35: Ukudinwa kuchaphazela kakhulu ubomi bemihla ngemihla
SleepHormones.36: Ukungalali kuyaqhubeka nangona izinto ezilungileyo zenziwa
SleepHormones.38: Ukubhala ixesha iingxaki ezihleli ngalo nento ebonakala ibachaphazela kunokunceda ingcali yakho yezempilo ikukhokele ngcono.
SleepHormones.40: Olu tshintsho lokulala luqhelekile kwaye ludla ngokuba lwethutyana: aluthethi ukuba kukho into engalunganga.
SleepHormones.41: I-Progesterone inempembelelo ethambileyo yokulala; ukwehla kwayo ekupheleni komjikelo kunokuphazamisa ukulala.
SleepHormones.42: Kwi-menopause, ukujika ubusuku yindlela eqhelekileyo yokuvuka.
SleepHormones.43: Inkqubo ezinzileyo yokulala negumbi elipholileyo ziyanceda ukunciphisa olu phazamiseko, nangayiphi na iminyaka.
SleepHormones.44: Iingxaki zokulala eziqhubekayo kufanelekile ukuba ziqwalaselwe nengcali yezempilo.
SleepHormones.45: Umxholo wolwazi. Eli nqaku alithathi indawo yengcebiso yezonyango ezenzelwe wena. Ukuba uthandabuza, funa ukhokelo kwingcali yezempilo.

UnderstandCycle.1: Qonda umjikelo wakho wexesha lenyanga · AWA
UnderstandCycle.8: Amanyathelo aphambili omjikelo wakho, achazwe ngokulula.
UnderstandCycle.19: Isigaba ngasinye sinendima ebalulekileyo emzimbeni wakho kwaye sinokuchaphazela amandla akho, imood yakho neempawu zakho.
UnderstandCycle.28: Iqanda likhululwa. Eli lixesha elinokuzala kakhulu.
UnderstandCycle.33: Umjikelo wakho unokwahluka ukusuka kwenyanga ukuya kwenye. Uxinzelelo, ukulala, ukutya okanye ukugula zinokuchaphazela ubude nesantya sawo.
UnderstandCycle.42: Mamela umzimba wakho, hlala unengqondo kwiimvakalelo zakho kwaye ubhale oko kutshintshayo ngokuhamba kweentsuku.

Ukuqonda ixesha lenyanga yakho:
okwenzeka ngokwenene
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.4: Ixesha lenyanga yakho licwangciso lwendalo olubalulekileyo empilweni yehomoni nenzala. Ukuqonda okwenzeka emzimbeni wakho kunokukunceda uzive ukhululekile kumjikelo ngamnye.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.7: Indlela ixesha lenyanga yakho elihamba ngayo
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.10: Ixesha lenyanga kukuphalaza kolwelo lwesibeleko xa kungekho kukhawulwa okuye kwenzeka. Oku kwenzeka ngomndilili kanye ngenyanga.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.12: Umfazi ngamnye wahlukile: ubude, ubukhulu, neemvakalelo zinokwahluka ukusuka kumjikelo ukuya komnye.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.13: Ukuhamba kwegazi akufani ngalo lonke ixesha lenyanga yakho. Kudla ngokutshintsha ngosuku, ngobukhulu, ngombala, nangokubonakala.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.15: Ukuhamba kwegazi kudla ngokuba kukhulu ngeentsuku zokuqala ezimbalwa.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.17: Ukuhamba kwegazi ngokubanzi kuqala ukuncipha ngokuthe ngcembe.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.19: Ukuhamba kwegazi kuba lula kwaye kunokuba nombala omnyama.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.21: Oku kunokwahluka ukusuka kumjikelo ukuya komnye. Okubalulekileyo kukwazi isantya sakho esiqhelekileyo.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.22: Utshintsho oluthile luqhelekile ngexesha lenyanga. Ezinye iimpawu zifanele ingqwalaselo engakumbi, ngakumbi xa zintsha okanye zinkulu kakhulu.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.24: Ixesha lenyanga elidla ngokuhlala iintsuku ezimbalwa.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.26: Ukuhamba kwegazi okukhulu ekuqaleni, emva koko okulula.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.28: Ukusuka kubomvu obukhanyayo ukuya kubomvu obumnyama okanye ntsundu ngasekupheleni kwexesha lenyanga yakho.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.33: Ukopha okuntywilisela ipad okanye itampon ngokukhawuleza kakhulu
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.34: Ukudinwa okukhulu, ukuziva uzakuwa, okanye isiyezi
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.36: Izinto ezilula zinokunceda ukunciphisa ukungakhululeki nokwenza iintsuku zokuqala zexesha lenyanga yakho zikhululeke ngakumbi.

VaginalRing.12: Iringi sisixhobo esithambileyo esikhupha rhoqo imilinganiselo emincinci yeehomoni ngqo endleleni yomfazi, sinesenzo esifanayo sokuthintela uzalo nepilisi edibeneyo.
VaginalRing.20: Uyifaka wedwa, ihlala indawo yayo rhoqo iiveki ezintathu, emva koko iyakhutshwa kwiveki enye yokuphumla apho ixesha lenyanga lenzeka khona.
VaginalRing.27: Indawo echanekileyo endleleni yomfazi ayifuni ukuchaneka ukuze isebenze, nto leyo eyenza ukuba ilula ukuyisebenzisa.
VaginalRing.28: Iringi inamanqaku asebenzayo amaninzi ekufanele ukuwazi phambi kokuyikhetha.
VaginalRing.32: Ngokubanzi ihlala indawo yayo iiveki ezintathu.
VaginalRing.34: Iihomoni zikhutshwa rhoqo ngexesha lonke lokusetyenziswa.
VaginalRing.38: Hlamba izandla phambi kokuyifaka okanye ukuyikhupha
VaginalRing.39: Khetha ixesha elilula ukulikhumbula ukugcina uqwalaselo lweshedyuli
VaginalRing.40: Hlola ngamanye amaxesha ukuba isekhona endaweni yayo
VaginalRing.41: Jonga incwadana yengcaciso ukuba iyashenxa okanye iyakhutshwa
VaginalRing.43: Ukukhutshwa okanye ukushenxa ixesha elide kunokufuna ukhokelo oluthile. Hlala ujonga incwadana yengcaciso yesixhobo okanye ubuze ingcali yezempilo ukuba uthandabuza.
VaginalRing.48: Ngokubanzi ilandela umjikelo weeveki ezintathu kunye neveki enye yokuphumla.
VaginalRing.50: Ukuhlola rhoqo ukuba isendaweni yayo kukunceda usebenzise isixhobo unoxolo lwentliziyo.
VaginalRing.54: Iringi yendlela yomfazi idibanisa ukukhutshwa rhoqo kwehomoni nesantya sokusetyenziswa esingafuni isixa semihla ngemihla. Nangona kunjalo, ukhetho lokuthintela uzalo kufuneka lulungiswe kumntu ngamnye kwaye luxoxwe nengcali yezempilo.

week1.0: Ukukhawulwa kubalwa ukususela kumhla wokuqala wexesha lenyanga lokugqibela, ngokwesiqhelo sezonyango. Kweli nqanaba, ukukhawulwa ngokubanzi akukenzeki.
week1.1: Eli xesha ngokubanzi lisandulela ukukhawulwa; ngokuqhelekileyo akukabikho tshintsho lomzimba olumalunga nokukhawulwa.
week1.2: Ukubala ukukhawulwa ukususela kwixesha lenyanga lokugqibela kunika indlela eqhelekileyo yokulinganisela umhla wokuzalwa, nangona ukukhawulwa kwenzeka kamva kancinane.

week2.0: I-Ovulation nokukhawulwa okunokwenzeka ngokubanzi kwenzeka ngeli xesha, kuxhomekeke kubude bomjikelo womntu ngamnye.
week2.1: Ixesha le-ovulation linokwahluka ngokobude bomjikelo, nto leyo echaphazela umhla wokwenene onokwenzeka wokukhawulwa.
week2.2: Ngokubanzi akukabikho tshintsho lomzimba olukhethekileyo lokukhawulwa kweli nqanaba.
week2.3: Ixesha elichanekileyo le-ovulation lwahluka ngomntu ngamnye, yiyo loo nto eli xesha lihlala lilinganiselo.

week3.0: Ukuba ukukhawulwa kuye kwenzeka, iqanda liqala ukwahlukana kwaye lihambe liye esibelekweni, kodwa akukabikho into ebonakalayo kuvavanyo lokukhawulwa.
week3.1: Le veki isawela ngaphakathi kwexesha lokubala kwezonyango elijikeleze ukukhawulwa; akukho mpawu yomzimba ebonakalayo ngokubanzi kweli nqanaba.
week3.2: Uvavanyo lokukhawulwa lomchamo oluninzi luba nokuthenjwa ukusuka malunga neveki elandelayo, xa ukuncamathela sele kuqalile.

week4.0: Umbungu usandula ukuncamathela kodonga lwesibeleko. Isingxobo samanzi esibeleko kunye nesingxobo seqanda, ezizakumondla kwiintsuku zokuqala kakhulu, ziyakheka.
week4.3: Abanye abantu abayiboni mpawu okwangoku kweli nqanaba lokuqala kakhulu.
week4.4: Uvavanyo lokukhawulwa lomchamo ngokubanzi lunokubona ukukhawulwa ukususela kule veki ukuya phambili.
week4.5: Eli lixesha eliqhelekileyo apho uvavanyo lokukhawulwa lunokuqala ukunika isiphumo esiqinisekileyo.

week5.0: Inkqubo yemithambo-luvo iqala ukwakheka, kwaye intliziyo, esamncinci, ilizele ukubetha okokuqala.
week5.3: Ukudinwa okungaqhelekanga, isicaphucaphu esithambileyo, okanye ukuvuvukala kwamabele kunokuvela.
week5.4: Eli lixesha elicetyiswayo lokwenza idinga nengcali yezempilo ukuqala ukhathalelo lokukhawulwa.

week6.0: Ii-bud zengalo nemilenze ziyavela, kunye nezikhubekiso ezincinci apho iindlebe ziza kwakheka khona. Intliziyo ngamanye amaxesha sele inokubonwa kwi-ultrasound.
week6.3: Isicaphucaphu nokudinwa kunokwanda kwabanye abantu ngeli xesha.
week6.4: Umsebenzi wentliziyo ngamanye amaxesha unokubonwa kwangoko kule veki kwi-ultrasound yokuqala.

week7.0: Ingqondo ikhula ngokukhawuleza kunomzimba osele, inika impumlo ephumileyo. Ii-bud ezincinci zezandla ziqala ukuvela ekupheleni kweengalo.
week7.3: Ukulangazelela ukutya okuthile, okanye ngokuchaseneyo ukwenyanya ukutya okuthile, kuyenzeka.
week7.4: Itubhu yemithambo-luvo, enika ingqondo nomthambo womqolo, iqhubeka ivalwa ngeli xesha leeveki.

week8.0: Umbungu ngoku ubizwa ngokuba yifetus. Iingalo ziyanda, intloko iqala ukuthamba kancinane, kwaye ipleseta iqhubeka ikheka.
week8.3: Ukuvakala kwevumba nokugula kwakusasa kuqhelekile kweli nqanaba, nangona kungenjalo ngabo bonke.
week8.4: I-ultrasound yokuqala yokumisela umhla ngokubanzi icwangciswa phakathi kweveki 8 neveki 14.

week9.0: Iimpawu zobuso ziba zicace ngakumbi, amajwabu avikela amehlo, kwaye izandla neenyawo ziyakheka kunye neminwe yexesha elizayo.
week9.3: Ukudinwa okukhulu nesicaphucaphu zisenokubakho; zidla ngokuthamba ngasekupheleni kwetrimester yokuqala.
week9.4: Izitho zesini ziqala nje ukwahlukana, kodwa isini ngokubanzi asikwazi ukuchongwa kude kube kamva kakhulu, kwi-ultrasound yeanatomi.

week10.0: Ubuso buba nokwaziwa ngakumbi, amajwabu asabela ekukhanyeni, kwaye intliziyo ibetha ngesantya esikhawulezayo, malunga neentsuku ezintathu ngokukhawuleza kunoomntu abadala.
week10.3: Isinqe sakho sinokuqala ukutshintsha kancinane, nangona isisu ngokubanzi singabonakali okwangoku.
week10.4: Uhlolo oludibeneyo lwetrimester yokuqala, xa lunikezelwa, ngokubanzi lwenziwa phakathi kweveki 11 neveki 14.

week11.0: Iminwe yezandla neyeenyawo iyahlukana, ii-nail ezincinci ziyavela, kwaye ipleseta ithatha ngokuthe ngcembe indawo yesingxobo seqanda ekondleni ifetus.
week11.3: Unokubona ukutshintsha kwemood, okudityaniswe ngokukodwa notshintsho lwehomoni.
week11.4: Intshukumo yosana iyaqala, kodwa ngokubanzi ayivakali okwangoku kweli nqanaba.

week12.0: Izitho zangaphakathi nemisipha zikhule kakuhle, kwaye amathambo aqala ukuqina. Izitho zokuzala ziyakheke, nangona zingabonakali kwi-ultrasound okwangoku.
week12.3: Isicaphucaphu sidla ngokuthamba ngokuthe ngcembe malunga neli xesha, nangona oku kwahluka kakhulu ngomntu ngamnye.
week12.4: Isiphelo setrimester yokuqala sidla ngokudityaniswa nomngcipheko osezantsi wokuphelelwa yinkqubo yokukhawulwa xa kuthelekiswa neeveki ezandulelayo.

week13.0: Intshukumo, esasuka-suka, iba ngokulungelelana ngakumbi kancinane. Abanye osana sele bebonisa ukumunxa isithupha.
week13.3: Abantu abaninzi bayaphinda bafumane amandla amaninzi ngokuthe ngcembe njengoko itrimester yesibini isondela.
week13.4: Itrimester yokuqala ngokubanzi iphela malunga nale veki; ukhathalelo luqhubeka ngamadinga ahlukeneyo ngakumbi.

week14.0: Intloko iba ngqukuva ngakumbi kwaye iyalingana nomzimba osele. Ifetus imginya ulwelo oluncinci lwesibeleko, oludlula esiswini nakwizintso.
week14.3: Isisu siqala ukujikeleza ngakumbi kwabanye abantu.
week14.4: Ingcali yezempilo ngamanye amaxesha inokuqala ukuva ukubetha kwentliziyo ngesixhobo se-ultrasound esibekwe esiswini.

week15.0: Uboya obuhle obubizwa ngokuba yi-lanugo ngokuthe ngcembe bugubungela ulusu, kwaye iintshiya neentshiya zamehlo ziqala ukuvela. Amehlo ayabuthathaka ekukhanyeni.
week15.3: Ukutya kwakho kunokutshintsha, ngamanye amaxesha ngokulangazelela okanye ukwenyanya ukutya okutsha.
week15.4: Ukuva kuqala ukukhula malunga neli xesha: ilizwi lakho namandla angaphakathi omzimba ngokuthe ngcembe ayabonakala.

week16.0: Inkqubo yemithambo-luvo ivumela intshukumo yengalo nomlenze. Izandla zinokuvalwa zibe ziinqindi ezincinci.
week16.3: Abanye abantu baqala ukuvakalelwa yintshukumo elula kakhulu ukusuka malunga neli xesha, edla ngokuchazwa njengokubhabha.
week16.4: Ukuvakalelwa yintshukumo yokuqala kwahluka kakhulu ukusuka kukhawulo olunye ukuya kolunye, ngokukhethekileyo kuxhomekeke ekubeni ngowokuqala.

week17.0: Amehlo, asavaliwe, anokushukuma, kwaye usana ngoku lusabela kwimisindo ephezulu. Iimpawu zeminwe ziqala ukwakheka.
week17.3: Intlungu yomqolo ethambileyo inokuvela njengoko isiseko sakho sobunzima sishenxa.
week17.4: Imisindo yangaphandle iqala ukuvakala, ngendlela ethomalalisiweyo, ngolwelo lwesibeleko.

week18.0: Ukuva, ukuchukumisa, ukumginya, nokumunxa kuyaqhubeka nokukhula. Usana luba nomsebenzi ngakumbi, lunentshukumo yeengalo nemilenze emininzi.
week18.3: Isisu sidla ngokubonakala ngokucacileyo kweli nqanaba, kwaye isiseko sakho sobunzima siqhubeka sishenxa.
week18.4: I-ultrasound yeanatomi, ehlola ukukhula jikelele kosana, ngokubanzi inikezelwa phakathi kweveki 18 neveki 21.

week19.0: Amazinyo omlinganiswa wexesha elizayo aqala ukwakheka emva kwamazinyo osana alungiselelwayo, kwaye usana luqhubeka lunyuka ubunzima ngokuthe ngcembe.
week19.3: Imvakalelo yokutsala ngasemacaleni esisu (intlungu yesibopho esijikelezayo) inokwenzeka njengoko isibeleko sikhula.
week19.4: Eli lixesha eliqhelekileyo lokuqala ukuvakalelwa yintshukumo yosana ngokucacileyo ngakumbi.

week20.0: Ukususela kule veki ukuya phambili, ubude bulinganiswa ukusuka entloko ukuya kwisithende kunokuba ukusuka entloko ukuya emva, kuba imilenze ngoku inokolulwa kwaye ilinganiswe — oku kuchaza ukutsiba okubonakalayo kubungakanani bereferensi xa kuthelekiswa neeveki ezidlulileyo.
week20.3: Isisu sakho esijikelezileyo kakuhle sinokuqala ukuchaphazela ukulingana nokuma kwakho.
week20.4: Embindini wokukhawulwa udla ngokuphawulwa luhlolo olupheleleyo nengcali yezempilo elandela ukhathalelo lwakho.

week21.0: Intshukumo iba cacileyo kwaye ilungelelane ngakumbi, kwaye kuqhelekile ukuqala ukuvakalelwa yiyo ngokucacileyo ngeli xesha.
week21.3: Ukuphefumla ngokukhawuleza okuthambileyo ngexesha lomsebenzi kunokuvela njengoko isibeleko sithatha indawo engakumbi.
week21.4: Ukuqhelana nesantya sentshukumo esiqhelekileyo sosana lwakho kwenza kube lula ukubona utshintsho olungaqhelekanga.

week22.0: Imiphunga iqhubeka ikhula, kwaye usana luziqhelanisa nentshukumo encinci yokuphefumla. Iindawo zokungcamla nazo ziyakheka.
week22.3: Ukubanda kwemilenze, ngakumbi ebusuku, kuyenzeka kwabanye abantu.
week22.4: Oko utya kunokuchaphazela ulwelo lwesibeleko, olumginywa rhoqo ngusana.

week23.0: Imilenze nengalo ngoku zilingana kakuhle. Usana luziqhelanisa nokuphefumla kwaye luqala ukutshintshana phakathi kokulala nokuvuka.
week23.3: Intlungu yomqolo ebonakalayo ngakumbi inokuvela ngokunyuka kobunzima ngokuthe ngcembe.
week23.4: Ukubona amaxesha osana asebenzayo nathe cwaka kukunceda ufunde isantya salo.

week24.0: Usana lufikelela kumda wokuphila: ukuba kwenzeke ukuzalwa kwangaphambi kwexesha kakhulu kweli nqanaba, ukhathalelo lwezonyango lwabantwana abasanda kuzalwa olukhethekileyo lunokwenza ukuba luphile, ngenkxaso efanelekileyo.
week24.3: Uxinzelelo olwanda esibhobhozini nesidingo esiqhelekileyo sokuchama zinokuvela.
week24.4: Uvavanyo lwesifo seswekile sokukhawulwa ngokubanzi lunikezelwa malunga neli xesha.

week25.0: Usana ngoku lusabela kumsindo ophezulu ngokothuka okanye ukukhaba, kwaye ukuhlikihla ngamanye amaxesha kunokuvakala. Luchama rhoqo kulwelo lwesibeleko.
week25.3: Ukutshisa esifubeni okanye ukuphindela kweasidi kunokwenzeka rhoqo.
week25.4: Ukuhlikihla kwefetus okuvakala ngamanye amaxesha kudla ngokuthathwa njengokuqhelekileyo.

week26.0: Amehlo ayavuleka okokuqala. Umbala wawo wokugqibela ngokubanzi awuyi kwaziwa kude kube ngamanyathelo aliqela ezinyangeni emva kokuzalwa.
week26.3: Ukudumba okuthambileyo kweengxingo okanye iinyawo kunokuvela, ngakumbi ekupheleni kosuku.
week26.4: Itrimester yesithathu iyasondela, ngokulandelela kwezonyango ngokubanzi kuba rhoqo.

week27.0: Imiphunga iba nako ukuqalisa ukuphefumla, kwaye usana luqhubeka lukhula njengoko amafutha eqokelela phantsi kolusu.
week27.3: Ukudinwa kunokubuya njengoko umzimba wakho ukhwela ubunzima obunyukayo.
week27.4: Ukuqala kwetrimester yesithathu kudla ngokuba lixesha elihle lokuqala ukucinga ngecebo lakho lokubeleka.

week28.0: Isantya sentliziyo, esikhawulezayo ekukhawulweni kwangaphambili kakhulu, sizinzile malunga neebhithi ezili-130 ukuya kwezili-140 ngomzuzu kwaye ngoku sinokuviwa nge-stethoscope.
week28.3: Ukuphefumla ngokukhawuleza okanye ukutshisa esifubeni kunokwenzeka rhoqo njengoko isibeleko sithatha indawo engakumbi.
week28.4: Itrimester yesithathu ngokubanzi iqala malunga nale veki, namadinga eba rhoqo.

week29.0: Usana sele lwakheke kakuhle; iiveki ezizayo ziya kunikezelwa ikakhulu ekuvuthweni kwezitho nokunyuka kobunzima. Ulwakhiwo olubhityileyo lokukhusela olugubungela ulusu lwalo luqala ukufunxwa kwakhona.
week29.3: Ukulala kunokuba nzima ukukufumana ngenxa yesisu sakho esikhulayo.
week29.4: Ukuphumla ngecala lakho lasekhohlo kudla ngokucetyiswa ekupheleni kokukhawulwa ukuxhasa ukujikeleza kwegazi.

week30.0: Ukubona kuqhubeka kukhula; ekuzalweni, usana luya kukwazi ukwahlula ubuso obuseduze, phambi kokufunda ngokuthe ngcembe ukulandela izinto ezishukumayo.
week30.3: Imvakalelo yobunzima emqolweni ongezantsi okanye kwi-pelvis inokunyuka.
week30.4: Amadinga angaphambi kokuzalwa ngokubanzi aba rhoqo ukususela kweli nqanaba.

week31.0: Usana luhamba lusebenza, ngamanye amaxesha lumunxa iminwe, kwaye lunokwenza intshukumo ebanzi. Ulusu lwalo luba nemigangatho emincinci njengoko amafutha eqokelela.
week31.3: Ukuncipha kokuziqhelanisa, okwaziwa ngokuba yi-Braxton Hicks, kunokuqala ukuvakala ngamanye amaxesha.
week31.4: Usana luqala ukuqonda amazwi athile aqhelekileyo aviwa rhoqo ngaphandle.

week32.0: Usana sele lwakheke kakuhle kwaye luyazinza ngokuthe ngcembe intloko ingaphantsi ekulungiseleleni ukuzalwa. Luqhubeka ikakhulu ngokunyuka kobunzima ngeeveki eziseleyo.
week32.3: Ukunyuka kobunzima okubonakalayo ngakumbi kuqhelekile ngeli xesha, kudibene nokukhula kosana.
week32.4: Ukubeka intloko ngaphantsi (cephalic presentation) kuba luqhelekile ngakumbi njengoko ixesha lokuzalwa lisondela.

week33.0: Ingqondo nenkqubo yemithambo-luvo ngoku ikhule kakuhle. Amathambo aqhubeka eqina, ngaphandle kwamathambo ekhakhayi, asala ethambile ukwenza kube lula ukudlula ngexesha lokuzalwa.
week33.3: Ubunzima bokufumana indawo yokulala ekhululekileyo kuqhelekile kweli nqanaba.
week33.4: Ukuthamba kwamathambo ekhakhayi ekuzalweni kwethutyana kwaye kuvaleka ngokuthe ngcembe kunyaka wokuqala.
